t: The DEWALT Bolster safety boots are robust work footwear designed for trade professionals needing reliable foot protection. These men's steel toe cap safety boots feature a durable nubuck leather upper, offering both comfort and resilience on site. Ideal for various demanding work environments, the boots provide essential impact protection with a 200 Joule steel toe cap and SRA slip resistance for secure footing. A lightweight and flexible design, combined with a padded collar and tongue, ensures comfort during long shifts. The shock-absorbing EVA and rubber sole is also oil-repellent, enhancing safety and durability.
b: Not Tested for Sole Heat Resistance
